description: Building valuable SaaS tools means integrating with your users’ data, but adding third-party integrations is complicated. Learning about OAuth and maintaining the code for it sucks. Take a load off -- focus on building.

name: Zegashop
tagline: AI eCommerce Website Builder with Growth Strategy
description: With a fully optimized, out-of-the-box software solution and 97+ Google Core Web Vitals for mobile and desktop, you can easily drive organic traffic, provide a superior user experience, and focus on business growth using the built-in Growth Strategy.

name: ZenDump
tagline: Tell it anything. It remembers, watches, and reminds you.
description: ZenDump is now a full app on iOS and Android - and the brain dump got a brain. Talk to it: "push everything overdue to tomorrow, am I free at 3?" and it reschedules, edits, undoes, and reads your synced calendar for real gaps. ZenWatch monitors anything online and alerts you only when it changes. Chat with an AI that knows your notes, map memories in Memory Atlas, seal Time Capsule letters to future-you, catch renewals with ZenSpend. Rituals, Zenji, sharing. One dump, a life that runs itself.

name: Zwitch
tagline: Every app, one letter away.
description: A keyboard-first app switcher for macOS. Double-tap your leader key, hit a letter, and the app jumps to the front — no cycling, no mouse. Map H, J, K, L or anything else to the apps you actually use. Lives quietly in the menu bar. - No Permissions - Can not collide with traditional shortcuts
